description: Defines the QuicDatagramQueue class for buffering and managing QUIC datagrams, including an observer interface for event notifications.

classes.name: quic::QuicDatagramQueue
classes.description: Manages buffering and transmission of QUIC datagrams with support for expiration and event observation.

classes.name: quic::QuicDatagramQueue::Observer
classes.description: Interface for monitoring datagram processing events such as sent or discarded datagrams.

methods.name: SendOrQueueDatagram
methods.description: Adds a datagram to the queue or sends it immediately if possible.

methods.name: TrySendingNextDatagram
methods.description: Attempts to send the next datagram in the queue.

methods.name: SendDatagrams
methods.description: Sends all unexpired datagrams until blocked or empty.

methods.name: GetMaxTimeInQueue
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed time a datagram can stay in the queue.

methods.name: SetMaxTimeInQueue
methods.description: Sets the maximum time a datagram can stay in the queue.

methods.name: SetForceFlush
methods.description: Configures whether datagrams should be sent with the flush flag.

methods.name: queue_size
methods.description: Returns the current number of datagrams in the queue.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.
